description: Invites a new member (or re-invites an existing non-accepted member) to a Sentry organization via email, allowing specification of organization and team roles.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for inviting or adding a member to an organization.

email.description: The email address of the user to invite or add to the organization.
email.title: Email

orgRole.description: Primary organization-level role. `billing`: Manages payment/compliance. `member`: Views events/data. `manager`: Manages teams, projects, membership. `owner`: Unrestricted access. `admin`: Edits global integrations, manages projects/teams. Note: The `admin` role may have plan-specific restrictions; consider `manager` or `teamRoles`.
orgRole.title: Org Role

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID or slug) of the Sentry organization to which the member will be added.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

reinvite.description: If `True`, resends an invitation to a user previously invited but who has not yet accepted.
reinvite.title: Reinvite

sendInvite.description: If `True`, an invitation email is sent to the user. Set to `False` to add the member without an email notification.
sendInvite.title: Send Invite

teamRoles.description: List of team-specific role assignments. Common roles: `contributor` (views/acts on issues, may add members per org settings) and `admin` (full team/project management).

items.description: Represents a team role assignment. Used within the `teamRoles` list in `AddOrganizationMemberViaEmailRequest`.

role.description: The role to assign the member within this team. `contributor`: Can view and act on issues (may add team members per org settings). `admin`: Full management access to the team's membership and projects.
role.title: Role

teamSlug.description: The slug of the team to assign the member to.
teamSlug.title: Team Slug

items.title: TeamRolesRequest

teamRoles.title: Team Roles
